in_sanskrit.name: Ravansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sun's delight, Raven's son
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ravansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ravansh is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Ravana' and 'Sh' which means the Sun's delight and Raven's son respectively. This name signifies a powerful and courageous personality who possesses immense intelligence and wisdom. Ravansh is a name of royal lineage and is often given to children born in auspicious times.
